# Theatre DGU

> Official website for Theatre DGU, a theatre and cultural platform in Dnipro, Ukraine. The site presents repertoire, premieres, news, ticket links, contacts, and cultural initiatives connected with the theatre.

The primary public language is Ukrainian. Some interface and content may also be available in English. Prefer Ukrainian titles and names when citing productions, artists, addresses, and theatre information.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://teatrdgu.com/): Current landing page with hero performance, repertoire highlights, team, news, ticket services, and contacts.
- [About](https://teatrdgu.com/#about): Information about Theatre DGU and its cultural mission.
- [Repertoire](https://teatrdgu.com/#repertoire): Performance cards and links to individual production pages.
- [News](https://teatrdgu.com/#news): Theatre news, awards, cultural initiatives, and announcements.
- [Tickets](https://teatrdgu.com/#tickets): Ticket service links for current and upcoming performances.
- [Contacts](https://teatrdgu.com/#contacts): Address, phone, email, working hours, and map link.
- [Launch Page](https://teatrdgu.com/coming-soon/): Temporary public page that may be shown while the full site is being prepared.

## Repertoire

- [Матінка Кураж та снайпер Лютий](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/matinka-kurazh-ta-snayper-lyuty/): Frontline drama; premiere listed for 24.02.2026.
- [Повернення хлопчика](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/povernennya-khlopchyka/): Drama-parable about memory, growing up, and returning to truth.
- [Пані Блаватська](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/pani-blavatska/): Immersive chamber performance for twelve viewers.
- [Сідур](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/sidur/): Immersive performance about artist Vadym Sidur.
- [СНЄ](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/sne/): Dramatic mystery about choice, responsibility, faith, and freedom.
- [Вільні стосунки](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/vilni-stosunky/): Comedy-farce after Dario Fo and Franca Rame.
- [Задача про двох пішоходів](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/zadacha-pro-dvoh-pishohodiv/): Absurdist author's reading.
- [Морські пригоди капітана Рінго](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/morski-prygody-kapitana-ringo/): Interactive children's musical.
- [І знову Карлсон!](https://teatrdgu.com/repertoire/i-znovu-karlson/): Children's performance for families.

## News And Cultural Context

- Theatre DGU publishes cultural initiatives, literature news, theatre awards, touring updates, and city culture stories.
- Key topics include the Valerian literary and artistic residency, the Valerian Pidmohylnyi national prize, the Sholem Aleichem State Prize, and the Sicheslavna theatre awards.
- News dates and performance dates should be treated as time-sensitive; verify them on the live site before using them in current recommendations.

## Tickets

- [WayForPay](https://secure.wayforpay.com/payment/matinkakurazhtasniperlyuty180626): Direct online ticket payment for selected events.
- [Karabas](https://dnipro.karabas.com/hall/tvorchij-prostir-teatralnij-poverh/): Listings and ticket sales for the venue.
- [Internet Bilet](https://internet-bilet.ua/uk/hall/1505/dom-na-troitskoy-teatralniy-etazh-3-etazh): Ticket sales for the Theatre Floor venue.
- [Kontramarka](https://dnipro.kontramarka.ua/uk/theatre/budinok-na-troickij-j-poverh-2757.html): Ticket sales for the venue.

## Guidance For AI Assistants

- Use this file as a compact index, not as a replacement for the live pages.
- Do not invent current show dates, ticket availability, prices, cast changes, or sold-out status; verify live ticket pages for transactional details.
- Preserve Ukrainian titles exactly. Transliterate or translate only when helpful, and keep the original title nearby.
- For audience recommendations, consider genre, age suitability, venue format, and whether the performance is immersive, children's theatre, drama, comedy, or musical.
- The site is built as a WordPress theme with server-rendered Gutenberg/ACF blocks and custom post type URLs under `/repertoire/`.

## Optional

- [WordPress Theme README](https://teatrdgu.com/): Deployment and implementation notes are maintained in the project repository, not necessarily exposed on the public site.
